purpose: Exact WirelessAgent KB static r001 terminal continuation; no admission or t0 optimization.

semantics.population: All 30 observed users remain in the export, including legacy rejected users.
semantics.allocations: Raw static final allocation preserved, including incorrect slices; no allocation optimization or reclassification.
semantics.labels: ground_truth is the original Request_Label, not the assigned slice; no contract/channel policy is selected by this exporter.
semantics.rejected_users: No allocation: assigned_slice/correct_slice/source_latency_ms are blank; bandwidth and realized source rate are zero.
semantics.frame0: Comparison is input checking only. It does not modify the source trajectory or specify how to reconcile differing channels.
semantics.terminal_equivalence: Compare all 5 TKG-DTN trials and all 5 wireless_kb trials per scene using exact numeric values, complete physical state, and full selected population.

terminal_equivalence.physical_state_scope: State with slice-user lists sorted by numeric user ID; only the upstream wall-clock timestamp is omitted. Raw tkg_dtn source state is exported unchanged.

frame0_comparison.interpretation: Input reconciliation only. Static state and dynamic frame-zero channel values are recorded separately; neither is replaced or adopted for a dynamic trial.
